port.ask: Serial port the circulator appears on (COM4, /dev/ttyACM0, /dev/tty.usbmodem*)
port.help: USB-B: install the JULABO USB driver (STMicroelectronics Virtual COM Port on Windows); the unit then shows as a COM port. RS-232: the port of the null-modem cable.

baud.ask: Baud rate: 9600 on the USB virtual COM port; 4800 is the RS-232 factory default on older units
